name: io.github.merulocal/hellogrowthcrm-bot-crawler
description: Read-only HelloGrowthCRM website mirror (pricing, features, integrations, comparisons, guides) plus bot governance: discover, identify and govern every bot hitting your website with reverse-DNS identity verification and policy-driven robots.txt generation. No customer data, no CRM actions, no API key required.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_TARGET_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL used by scan_website_bots and generate_robots_txt when no url argument is given.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_ACCESS_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Fallback Apache/Nginx combined-format access log path used by analyze_access_logs.

environmentVariables.name: CRAWLER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: User-Agent the crawler identifies itself with on outbound fetches.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SITEMAP_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of sitemap pages fetched in a single crawl run.

environmentVariables.name: CRAWL_DELAY_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-host delay between outbound requests, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info or debug.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Supabase project URL. Only needed for the blog, help, newsletter, forms and analytics tools.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Supabase service-role key. Only needed for the blog, help, newsletter, forms and analytics tools.
